pairs.difference: A: crisp small white hot spots on red/blue/green panels, firm dark cast shadow on sand to the right. B: broader softer sheen, flatter turn, shading range 0.533 is below real cards; shadow is a soft pool at left.
pairs.fix: Add a clear core shadow on the lower right of the ball, a deeper turn from light to dark, and a tight dark contact shadow under the ball.

pairs.difference: Both have a lit target face, a glossy teddy and warm bulb glow with soft contact shadows. Measures sit inside the real ranges and I see no consistent difference.
Both units have a soft broad gradient on the shell, a dark vent slot and a blue airflow glow. Light bias is above the real range on both. I see no clear difference in which one is generated.

A: the chest's lid interior and right side drop to near-black against bright gold, so the range sits at the top of the real range (0.906). B: a gentler turn on the wood, with a soft sand shadow to the right.
pairs.fix: Keep the lid interior from going to flat black. Open the shadow side with a warm bounce from the sand.

pairs.difference: A: bright even light with a crisp shadow on the floor and the gold sheen on the brim. B: dark moody corner with a hard window shadow wedge, a glossy flat brim edge and a dim anchor badge. The scene is lit unlike the bright, evenly lit real cards.
pairs.fix: Light the hat as in a bright cheerful scene. Use a soft broad sheen on the white crown, one key light with a gentle shadow, and no dark window wedge.

pairs.difference: A: the left face is lit and the cast shadow on the left ground is crisp. B: the left glass side drops into a flat blue-grey shade and the base has a soft, lighter contact shadow. B's light bias is above real cards.
pairs.fix: Give the booth one consistent light side and a short dark contact shadow at the base.

pairs.difference: A: sharp glossy white hot spots on the fins and a strong cast shadow, with light bias at 0.112 below the real range. B: a soft matte sheen with a gentle rim.
pairs.fix: Replace the sharp white hot spots with one broad soft sheen along the fin edge.

pairs.difference: A: the fins' yellow blades are blown out to near white with hard hot spots, and the dark purple cuffs are very dark. Shading range 0.867 and form contrast 0.762 are above the real ranges. B: moderate sheen and a gentle turn within range.
pairs.fix: Lower the blown highlights on the yellow blades. Make the turn from light to shade on the fins gentler.

pairs.difference: A: the pier is evenly lit with no strong shadow on the water or sand beneath the deck. B: a darker shadow on the water next to the posts, a ring ripple and a rope with a clear lit side.
pairs.fix: Add a dark cast shadow under the deck and posts on the water, with light and shadow sides on the posts.

pairs.difference: A: the palm casts a strong shadow on the sand, and the trunk has a dark side. B: the fronds and trunk show no visible cast shadow on the sand, and the trunk is evenly lit.
pairs.fix: Add a soft dark palm shadow across the sand and shade the right side of the trunk.

pairs.difference: A: strong black recess and glossy rim light on the locker, with shading range 0.863. B: a soft floor shadow and an evenly lit orange body.
pairs.fix: Open the locker interior shadow and use one soft sheen on the orange door.

pairs.difference: A: a bright sunlit slide with a cast shadow on the tiles and a lit splash. B: a deep blue-black underside inside the spiral and little shadow cast onto the deck or the tiles.
pairs.fix: Lighten the dark inside of the spiral with green bounce light and add a clear shadow of the slide on the deck.

pairs.difference: Both players have a bright top face and a soft darker underside, with broad sheens on the earbuds and no cast shadow. The two are close.
Both envelopes are cream with a soft gradient and a gentle sheen on the lower edge, and both photos have a bright, even light. I see no consistent difference.
Both fruit plates have wet specular highlights on the fruit, a glass rim and a soft table shadow. No clear difference on this vector.
A: dappled shadows from the ivy fall on the door and a lit door frame edge. B: the door and the wreath are evenly lit with no shadows from the ivy or the wreath, and the lower door shading is flat.
pairs.fix: Add soft cast shadows from the ivy and the wreath onto the blue door, and a darker side on the door frame.

pattern: The generated cards usually have lighting that is too even or too tidy. Cast shadows from nearby objects are missing, shadow sides are either too flat or too gently turned, and highlights are tidy, repeated sheens.
